perspectives.title: Columbus Condemned

representative_posts.author: stupendousman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The best I can do is to try and present truth. As regards the explorations in the Indies of Columbus perhaps the most accurate recounting is found in Bartolome de las Casas "A Short Account of the Destruction of the Indies." Be warned this is heartbreaking. web.as.uky.edu/history/facu...

representative_posts.author: catone85.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Columbus did not discover America, but his voyage reports encouraged others to do more exploring. While Amerigo Vespucci gets the credit for his discoveries in the New World, the land was already occupied by millions of indigenous people, who we refer to as Indians, but did not come from India.

representative_posts.author: unnameduserid.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Columbus was a human trafficker. museumfacts.co.uk/atrocities-c...
